q: Is attendance at Orientation Days mandatory?
a: Yes. Orientation Days deliver the statutory training on student rights and duties, so attendance is mandatory for all first-year students.

q: What if I cannot attend on my assigned day?
a: Write to dni.adaptacyjne@samorzad.ue.wroc.pl and we will agree on how you can complete the mandatory training.

q: Where does the event take place?
a: On the UEW campus at Komandorska 118/120 in Wroclaw. Part-time students join online on Saturday.

q: I am a part-time student. Do I have to come to campus?
a: No. Part-time students join an online broadcast on Saturday, 3 October. The link will appear on this site and in News.
Comfortable shoes, a charged phone and a good mood. Details about documents will be posted in News before the event.

q: What is the dress code for UE Party x DA?
a: Party details, including the dress code, are in the UE Party x DA event on Facebook.

q: Where do I find live updates during the event?
a: In the News section of this site and in the Facebook event. Room and time changes are announced there as they happen.
